name: sessionlog_ingest_path
description: Ingest a transcript file or folder from a workspace-contained or allowlisted server-local path.

path.description: Transcript file or folder path, workspace-relative or allowed absolute path.

source.description: Optional transcript source: Auto, Claude, Codex, Grok, Cline, Copilot, or OpenCode.

strict.description: Whether malformed records fail the bundle.

persist.description: Whether to persist through the ingestion persistence path.

compatibilityProfile.description: Optional compatibility profile: None, Claude, Codex, or Grok.

emitNormalizedProfile.description: Whether to emit the selected compatibility profile artifact.
